title: Etale-proetale comparison for supported sections and their exterior products
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and $A$ a finite commutative ring. All coefficient categories below are ordinary sheaves of modules over the constant sheaf of rings $A$, not condensed coefficient categories. For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], separated in the diagonal sense [def-weil-proper-morphism], a closed subscheme $C\subseteq T$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], and $M\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, write $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], with its bounded-below inverse image as in [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. There is a canonical isomorphism
$$
c^C_{T,M}:R\Gamma_C(T_{\mathrm{et}},M)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma_C(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\nu_T^*M),
$$
natural in $M$ and compatible with open restriction and forgetting supports. Here both support functors are the ordinary right-derived sections with support [def-pur-support-cohomology]. For $C=T$ this map is the global-sections comparison induced by the comparison adjunction unit.

Let $Z\subseteq X$ and $W\subseteq Y$ be closed subschemes of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $L\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and suppose $F=K\boxtimes_A^L L$ is bounded below. Products are fibre products over $k$ [def-pc-base-change], with projections $p_X,p_Y$, and $K\boxtimes_A^L L$ means $p_X^*K\otimes_A^Lp_Y^*L$. Put $K_p=\nu_X^*K$, $L_p=\nu_Y^*L$, $P=X\times_kY$. Let
$$
\theta:\nu_P^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}K_p\boxtimes_A^L L_p
$$
be the composite of the canonical derived tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and the comparison pullback identifications [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. The supported exterior products [def-pur-supported-exterior-product] in the two topologies satisfy the equality in $D(A)$, the unbounded derived category of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]
$$
R\Gamma_{Z\times_kW}(P_{\mathrm{proet}},\theta)\circ c^{Z\times_kW}_{P,F}\circ\kappa^{Z,W}_{K,L}
=\kappa^{Z,W}_{K_p,L_p}\circ(c^Z_{X,K}\otimes_A^Lc^W_{Y,L}).
$$
The pro-etale exterior product here is defined by pulling back and tensoring supported sections, derived with K-flat tensor and injective support resolutions in that topology. The assertion concerns comparison of these maps; it does not assert a Kunneth isomorphism in either topology.
